title: NetBreaker: Benchmarking Network Dismantling across Objectives, Scales, and Toplogoies
abstract: arXiv:2611.19298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Network dismantling seeks to fragment a network with as few node removals as possible, which is widely applied in vulnerability analysis, epidemic containment, and infrastructure protection. Although learning-based methods have become increasingly prominent, their progress remains difficult to assess because existing studies differ in method coverage, datasets, evaluation criteria, and experimental protocols. Thus, we introduce NetBreaker, a comprehensive benchmark designed for the learning era of network dismantling. NetBreaker organizes 30 methods (18 non-learning and 12 learning-based) under a common taxonomy and evaluates them on 185 networks from eight unified domains, ranging from 14 to 1.69 million nodes. To enable fair comparison, heterogeneous method outputs are converted into node removal sequences and assessed under a unified execution protocol. translated_title: NetBreaker：跨目标、规模与拓扑的网络瓦解基准测试
translated_abstract: 网络瓦解旨在通过移除尽可能少的节点来使网络碎片化，广泛应用于脆弱性分析、疫情遏制和基础设施保护等领域。尽管基于学习的方法日益受到关注，但由于现有研究在方法覆盖范围、数据集、评估标准和实验协议上各不相同，其进展仍难以评估。为此，我们提出了NetBreaker，一个面向网络瓦解学习时代的综合基准。NetBreaker在统一的分类体系下组织了30种方法（18种非学习方法和12种基于学习的方法），并在来自八个统一领域的185个网络上进行评估，网络规模从14个节点到169万个节点不等。为实现公平比较，异构方法的输出被统一转换为节点移除序列，并在统一的执行协议下进行评估。评估涵盖四个互补维度：基于目标的有效性、……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了NetBreaker——一个面向网络瓦解学习时代的综合基准，以统一分类体系组织30种方法，在八个领域185个规模从14到169万节点的网络上，通过统一执行协议和四个互补维度实现系统、公平的评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NetBreaker, a comprehensive benchmark for the learning era of network dismantling, which organizes 30 methods under a common taxonomy and fairly evaluates them on 185 networks across eight domains (14 to 1.69 million nodes) under a unified execution protocol and four complementary dimensions.
